text:
Ava Chen: Quick heads-up — change window tomorrow 02:00 UTC. We need final go/no-go by 23:30 UTC tonight. deploy-bot will kick a canary at 01:10 UTC.
Mike Patel: Ack. Finalized release notes in the doc. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/releases/2026-03-21
Priya Rao: QA smoke passed on staging 3x. Two flaky tests left (embedding cache) but covered by canary gating.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by @Ava Chen for 2026-03-21T01:10:00Z - job id 5621. Steps: deploy -> health-check -> traffic-shift(5%).
Jordan Li: I'll monitor latency graphs and KV cache hit rate. Alert thresholds set: 99th latency > 350ms or error rate > 0.8% -> rollback.
Sara Gomez: Rollback triggers noted. Add assertion: embedding-dot-product similarity drop > 2% over baseline -> rollback.
Lucas Moretti: Ops note: Pin older model v2.3 as fallback on dedicated capacity. Command: /pin model v2.3 --scope=dedicated
ops-bot: Model pin created: v2.3 pinned to dedicated pool until 2026-03-28. TTL 7d.
Mike Patel: Reminder: silent period from 23:30-02:30 UTC. No non-critical merges during window.
Ava Chen: Checklist snapshot - docs updated; DBA migrations scheduled outside window; oncall rotation: Jordan + Sara; rollback runbook pinned in ops channel.
Priya Rao: Can we add a post-deploy smoke script to run after traffic shift? I'll attach gist. /run smoke-post-deploy.sh
Jordan Li: Monitoring looks green during last dry-run. I'll be on call and zoom ready. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary started - job 5621 -> state: in-progress
Ava Chen: If anything looks off, shout in #eng-releases and hit the emergency unpin channel. @ops-bot will auto-rollback on critical alerts.
Mike Patel: Good luck team. :rocket:
